scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
scripts.deploy:api: gcloud run deploy plutus-api --source . --region us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated --set-env-vars NODE_ENV=production
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.android:add: npm run build && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
